questions.prompt: A client says "we need more growth." What question makes the requirement actionable?

options.a: Promise a 50 percent sales increase before any evidence
options.b: Offer the costliest package without asking about goals
options.c: Ask which customer action, baseline and time window define success

questions.feedback: Discovery identifies the client's actual goals, constraints and decision process before proposing work.

questions.prompt: A restaurant says its marketing campaign must be ready "soon." What should a consultant confirm?

options.a: Begin production without any approved briefing
options.b: Confirm the date, approval owner, required creative assets and launch dependencies
options.c: Assume the next business day is the deadline

questions.feedback: Discovery identifies the client's actual goals, constraints and decision process before proposing work.

questions.prompt: A contract contains four edited videos; a client requests ten at the original cost. What is fair?

options.a: Reject all agreed in-scope revision requests
options.b: Offer a documented change order with revised time, deliverables and fees
options.c: Promise extra six videos free without assessing feasibility

questions.feedback: Written scope and exclusions should remain clear when client needs change.

questions.prompt: A proposal lists creative service fees but excludes paid advertisements. How must the total be described?

options.a: List paid ad spend as separately authorized and explicitly excluded from service fees
options.b: Describe advertising spend as included without any budget
options.c: Add an unexpected media bill after the client signs

questions.feedback: Written scope and exclusions should remain clear when client needs change.

questions.prompt: A prospect says the quote exceeds the approved budget. How should a seller respond?

options.a: Ask which goals matter most and offer transparent lower-scope alternatives
options.b: Create a fake offer expiry in one hour
options.c: Insist on full payment regardless of the budget cap

questions.feedback: Consultative negotiation should use accurate information and respect buyer constraints.

questions.prompt: A buyer says a partner needs another week to review the offer. What is an ethical next step?

options.a: Send messages every hour until acceptance
options.b: Claim there is another buyer when no such request exists
options.c: Respect the approval process and agree a reasonable follow-up time

questions.feedback: Consultative negotiation should use accurate information and respect buyer constraints.

questions.prompt: A signed campaign moves from account management to delivery. Which information should transfer?

options.a: Leave delivery to guess the promises from memory
options.b: Hide unresolved risks so the client stays confident
options.c: Share approved scope, owner, exclusions, asset list, milestones and known risks securely

questions.feedback: Accurate handover and explicit dependencies prevent scope disputes and missed expectations.

questions.prompt: A developer receives a signed project scope with no confirmed asset handover date. What should happen next?

options.a: Remove the asset dependency from the handover document
options.b: Confirm client asset deadlines and update dependent delivery dates before promising launch
options.c: Set an arbitrary delivery date without collecting required files

questions.feedback: Accurate handover and explicit dependencies prevent scope disputes and missed expectations.
